s.n: Bayou hush puppies with Cajun remoulade
s.how: Mix 200g fine cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp cayenne. Whisk in 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk, then fold in 3 sliced spring onions. Rest 10 minutes. Drop heaped teaspoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain on paper towel. For the remoulade, mix 150g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 1 tbsp chopped pickles, 1 tsp Cajun seasoning and a squeeze of lemon.

Peel and devein 800g green prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 2 tsp Cajun seasoning. Heat a large frying pan over high heat with 1 tbsp oil. Add the prawns in one layer and cook 90 seconds a side. Drop the heat, add 60g butter and 3 crushed garlic cloves and swirl for 1 minute until foaming. Squeeze over 1 lemon and scatter with chopped parsley. Serve straight from the pan with a sliced baguette.

m.n: Mama Boucher's chicken and sausage gumbo
m.note: Mama's kitchen out on the bayou
m.how: Stir 80g plain flour into 80ml oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until it turns dark brown like chocolate. Add 1 diced onion, 2 celery sticks and 1 green capsicum and cook 5 minutes. Add 600g diced chicken thigh, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun seasoning and 1.2L chicken stock, and simmer 1 hour. Add 200g sliced okra for 10 minutes. Serve over 300g steamed long grain rice with sliced spring onion and hot sauce.

w.how: Toast 200g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes. In a heavy saucepan, combine 200g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 120ml thickened cream and 40g butter. Stir over medium heat until it boils, then cook without stirring until it reaches 115C on a sugar thermometer, about 8 minutes. Take off the heat, add 1 tsp vanilla and the pecans and beat with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes until it thickens and turns cloudy. Quickly spoon rounds onto baking paper and leave 30 minutes to set.

d.n: High quality H2O cucumber lime cooler
d.note: Bobby's water, the high quality stuff
d.how: Stir 3 tbsp honey into 3 tbsp hot water until dissolved and cool. Slice 1 Lebanese cucumber into thin ribbons with a peeler. In a jug, muddle the juice of 3 limes, a handful of mint leaves and the honey syrup. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice and cucumber ribbons. Add 1L chilled sparkling water to the jug, stir gently and pour over. Garnish with lime wheels and mint sprigs.
